বাংলা EN

Anywhere in the country, on time.

Four hundred and ninety-five upazilas, a thousand delivery points, seventy-five hundred people on the road — one network.

That does not look like a tracking link or code. Paste the link from your SMS, or ask the sender for it.

Use the link or code from your SMS. No account needed. Want to send one?

  • 495 upazilas
  • 1,000 delivery points
  • 7,500 delivery personnel

Three jobs, one network

One letter or ten thousand parcels a month — the same riders, the same tracking.

  • Send a parcel

    Person to person or shop to buyer, anywhere in the country.

    See how

  • Track a parcel

    Open the link from your SMS. No account needed.

    See how

  • For business

    Pickup, cash on delivery, next-day payout and one dashboard.

    See how

The road a parcel actually takes

Pickup to hub, hub to doorstep — a person and a scan at every step.

  1. 1

    Pickup every day

    No cap on volume. A rider comes to your shop and scans each parcel out.

    A rider comes to your shop and scans out.

  2. 2

    Routed through a hub

    Every parcel passes a divisional hub, scanned end to end.

    Divisional hub, then the destination hub.

  3. 3

    A scan at every step

    Pickup, hub, out-for-delivery, handover — each one lands in the system.

    Every handover lands in the system.

  4. 4

    Payout the next day

    We collect the cash, the dashboard reconciles it, the money moves to your bank.

    Reconciled, then paid to your bank.

Steadfast, across the country

Every dot is an upazila. The amber ones are the eight divisional hubs every parcel routes through.

  • 1,000delivery points
  • 7,500delivery personnel
  • 8divisions
  • 64districts
  • 495upazilas
  • 330municipalities

Coverage

The network behind 300,000 shops

Collecting orders, collecting cash and reconciling both — in one dashboard.

  • 500 orders in one file

    Upload a spreadsheet; every row comes back with an ID and a tracking link.

  • Delivery Risk Check before you ship

    Type the number and see how many parcels that buyer took, and returned.

  • API and plugins

    Push orders straight from your own site and read the status back.

See it for business

Who ships with us

The country's larger brands and marketplaces move parcels on this network every day.

On the record

  • GPO licensed

    A licensed courier service of the GPO.

  • CSAB member

    Courier Services Association of Bangladesh.

  • ECAB member

    E-Commerce Association of Bangladesh.
